description: This file defines the Affiliate class in the Opencart admin mail controller, responsible for sending approval and denial email notifications related to affiliate accounts. It contains methods for composing and queuing email tasks specific to affiliate approval and denial processes.

classes.name: Affiliate
classes.description: Controller class managing email notifications for affiliate approval and denial within the Opencart admin system.

methods.name: approve
methods.description: Handles sending an approval email to the affiliate, composing email content, and queuing the email task.

methods.name: deny
methods.description: Handles sending a denial email to the affiliate, preparing email content, and queuing the email task.
